messages:
sam_support: Heads up — RetailCorp org-level latency dashboard is missing p95/p99 lines after the canary deploy an hour ago. Only avg and p50 are showing. Any ideas? cc @jamie_sre @lina_pm :eyes:
jamie_sre: Thanks Sam. Is this only the org-scoped dashboard or do service/team views show percentiles?
sam_support: Only the org view. Service/team views (service=api-gateway) still show p95/p99. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/latency?org=834
ben_platform: Hm. If raw/service-level shows percentiles but the org rollup does not, likely an aggregation/transform dropped the percentile field or the rollup function changed. Any recent ingest pipeline commits? :thinking_face:
lina_pm: I repro'd: Console -> Dashboards -> Latency -> select Org: RetailCorp -> 1h timeframe -> p95/p99 blank. I ran a quick SQL on analytics store: SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) FROM events WHERE org_id=834 GROUP BY time_bucket(1m); returns nulls for many buckets.
jamie_sre: Can you paste the analytics query log? Also check Prometheus/raw metrics to confirm percentiles exist upstream (to separate ingest vs store issue).
sam_support: Prometheus has series: latency_request_seconds: p95 and p99 visible. Screenshot attached in thread (uploaded).
ben_platform: That points at a transform or aggregator between prometheus and analytics store. Earlier today we merged PR #4826 that changes tag grouping for org-level rollups (it strips internal tag set before percentile aggregation).
ops_ana: PR 4826 changed rollup keys — might be dropping org_id when computing percentiles. Percentile functions need the full sample set; if grouping key changes unexpectedly you'll get empty aggregations.
jamie_sre: Running a quick grep on the transform service logs: 
```
2026-03-16T14:08:12Z transform-1 INFO processing batch id=ghf234 org_id=834
2026-03-16T14:08:12Z transform-1 WARN grouping keys reduced: [service] (org_id removed)
2026-03-16T14:08:12Z transform-1 INFO writing rollup: p50=32ms p95=null p99=null
```
Seems like the transform intentionally removed org_id before percentile aggregation.
ben_platform: Ok that's the bug. The change was meant to reduce cardinality for count histograms but accidentally ran for percentile aggregations too. We'll revert the transform change for percentile paths.
support-bot: Incident created: INC-4532 — Org-level percentile rollup regression. Priority P2. Assigned to: jamie_sre, ben_platform.
lina_pm: Quick mitigation: 1) revert PR 4826 for percentile aggregation branch, 2) kick a backfill job to recompute rollups for the last 6h, 3) verify dashboards. I can run the backfill once revert is deployed.
jamie_sre: Action items: ben revert patch and open hotfix PR; ops run backfill after deployment; sam notify RetailCorp CS rep about ETA.
sam_support: Notified RetailCorp AM (pinged in external thread). They want an ETA before EOD.
ben_platform: Revert PR in progress, opening hotfix PR now. Will link once CI passes. :hammer_and_wrench:
ops_ana: Backfill job queued: backfill-rollups --org 834 --metrics percentile --from -6h --to now. ETA ~25m after hotfix deploy.
jamie_sre: After backfill, please check dashboards and Prometheus->analytics parity for p95/p99. If still missing, enable debug on transform and capture a sample payload.
lina_pm: I'll update incident INC-4532 with status and estimated time.
sam_support: Thanks team. Please paste confirmation here when p95/p99 return. :thumbsup:
ben_platform: Hotfix PR merged and deploying to canary. CI green.
jamie_sre: Canary looks good — org dashboard shows p95/p99 on canary. Rolling to prod now.
ops_ana: Backfill started.
ben_platform: Prod deploy complete.
jamie_sre: Backfill finished. Verified p95/p99 lines present and aligned with service-level metrics. Marking INC-4532 resolved pending postmortem.
support-bot: Incident INC-4532 status -> RESOLVED.
sam_support: Confirmed with RetailCorp — looks good. Closing customer escalation. Thanks all. :tada:
